items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, budget commitment, or production work. AI spend was $963.569 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,390 calls, while revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: $4.92 aggregate commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned to a site. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, other operating costs, experiment-level cost, incremental outcomes, and owner-approved budget limits are absent. Continue only existing source-dated measurement, reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Minimum future measurement is a period-aligned cost ledger matched to site-attributed commission, experiment-level cost with incremental outcomes, and approved monthly limits with actual-versus-budget reporting. Do not treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, AI calls, SEO scores, or technical scores as financial returns; do not support revenue forecasts from this evidence.

Attribution disposition: retain aggregate provider revenue as explicitly unassigned. The available one-day revenue window and partial aggregate attribution do not support site economics or claims of financial upside. Preserve unknowns and do not infer infrastructure cost from AI spend.
